## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no secrets, local paths, or unrelated generated output.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for material behavior changes.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] `npm run contracts:test` passes when Solidity behavior or dependencies are affected.
- [ ] User-facing claims match the evidence available in the repository or onchain records.
- [ ] Documentation and deployment configuration are updated where required.
- [ ] I followed the private disclosure process for any security-sensitive finding.
